canonical_name: Asheville Gay Men's Chorus (Cantaria Inc. of Asheville)
summary: The Asheville Gay Men's Chorus is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit community chorus (legally Cantaria Inc. of Asheville) with a Board of Directors and Artistic Team, affiliated with GALA Choruses. It actively recruits and auditions new singers ('Join Your Voice to Ours!'), meaning it has a returning core membership of singers rather than a rotating public. The two listed events are performances by this standing chorus at a host venue, not the group itself.

evidence.note: Listing describes the Asheville Gay Men's Chorus as claiming its role as 'the transforming and transcending choral voice for our LGBTQ and affirming community', consistent with an ongoing community chorus rather than a one-off act.

Both units are performances hosted by the Unitarian Universalist Fellowship of Hendersonville; the venue is the recurring host, but the performing chorus is the entity with the persistent identity and membership.
Official site confirms it is a registered nonprofit (Cantaria Inc. of Asheville, dba Asheville Gay Men's Chorus) with a Board of Directors, Artistic Team, and dedicated 'Our History' page.

Site actively recruits singers via an auditions page ('Join Your Voice to Ours!'), confirming open membership with an audition process, a hallmark of a real member-based group rather than a static act.
Chorus is affiliated with GALA Choruses (Gay and Lesbian Association of Choruses) and supported by the North Carolina Arts Council, indicating an established, ongoing organization.
